main_body: sci-fi metallic wall face panels with pipes and vent
evidence: This is a terrain wall face strip (like the Beodeul wall references), which is naturally a vertical south face designed to sit below a roof/ceiling autotile. It has recessed panels, eave/trim shadows (rows 1, 6, 22), and protruding pipes/ledges.

style.evidence: Compared to the Beodeul wall references (which have rich plaster speckles, multi-tone wood grain, and per-stone shading), the candidate consists of large flat fills of solid blue-grey (e.g., rows 8-18 and 24-27 have long stretches and 6x10 blocks of a single colour with only 1-2 stray pixels). Shading ramps are shallow and geometric, lacking surface grain or rich tile density.
